integrity.proof_type: finite-dimensional spectral decomposition with exact algebraic phase matching

scientific_limitations: Finite regular graph bases only, with 1 <= degree <= order-2 and least adjacency eigenvalue at most -2.
Apex edges have a common weight in [1/2,1]; base edges are unit length.
The phase diagram is proved analytically; matrix experiments cover finite examples, not all graphs.
Prior work includes the unweighted exponent-one cone criterion; no novelty is claimed for it.
No independent historical-priority assessment or independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Weighted graph cones exhibit a sharp negative-type eigenspace transition
